title: Antique Chair
description:
• Marries tradition with eco-consciousness.
  • Tastefully reupholstered antique chair.
  • 100% reclaimed materials
  • Completely unique dye pattern
shortDescription: Paletta presents the "Classic Revival," a tastefully reupholstered antique chair that marries tradition with eco-consciousness. The chair’s sturdy wooden frame and elegant form have been preserved, while the seating is refreshed with a sustainable, plush rose fabric, and the backrest with a complementary grey tone. Maintaining the chair's original charm with a focus on environmental responsibility, this piece is a quiet nod to the past and a commitment to timeless, sustainable design.
